contentText:
The Type 01 , Jaguar's most important and divisive car in years, has arrived. The production follow-up to the polarising Type 00 concept , Jaguar says the electric, four-door grand tourer is its most powerful road car ever.

Even though the Type 00's design chief was reportedly fired earlier this year , most of its aesthetic has carried over to the final car, for better or worse. You can't buy it in that hot Miami pink though - didn't anyone tell them GTA VI is almost here?
